scope: Synthetic constrained antiplane piezoelectric benchmark; production nonlinear two-carrier material and HEX20 assembly; temperature prescribed everywhere; signed JE sampled from material response, not a thermal-equilibrium test

loading.initial_state: all unknown DOFs zero; no exact interior warm start

mechanical_contact_scope: D.normal=0 is not J.normal=0: piezoelectric polarization cancels dielectric displacement while the outer eta Dirichlet contacts exchange carriers. This is not steady generation by a completely insulated, mechanically free plate.

exact.anchor: first outer-boundary mesh node; only the otherwise natural field is anchored there

boundaries.kinematic: u1=u2=0 at every node; u3 is solved except mechanical outer values or electric single anchor
boundaries.electric_case: outer phi exact; natural zero u3 traction plus one w anchor
boundaries.mechanical_case: outer w exact; natural zero D.normal plus one phi gauge
boundaries.carrier: eta_n=eta_p=0 only on outer boundary; hole and thickness faces natural zero current
boundaries.hole: zero antiplane traction, electric displacement flux and both carrier currents
boundaries.thickness: u1/u2 constraints can sustain nonzero opposing shear tractions; u3 traction sigma33=0; D3=Jn3=Jp3=0; report directly integrated thickness-face tangential traction RMS

normalization.nonzero_fields: integral relative L2 and relative gradient L2 against exact fields
normalization.stress: exact far-field amplitude |c44*A+e15*B|; if zero use 110000 Pa
normalization.electric_displacement: exact far-field amplitude |e15*A-epsilon11*B|; if zero use 1.1e-6 C/m2
normalization.carrier_flux: q*N*mu*abs(B), or abs(B)=0 reference E0=10000 V/m
normalization.heat: sigma*B^2, or B=0 reference sigma*E0^2; actual material Q used

gates.decreasing: all nonzero exact field and gradient errors, Q error and nonzero hole-normal channels strictly decrease on all three levels; zero exact channels are checked against frozen absolute-normalized gates, not noise monotonicity

independent_error_quadrature: 5x5x5 volume; 5x5 faces; 21 equispaced samples per wall element for peak including quadrant endpoints
outputs: new status=new CSV nodal and wall files per case/level, summary CSV, stdout metrics; do not overwrite old A2
source: Wang/Pan/Roy, Acta Mechanica 193 (2007), DOI 10.1007/s00707-007-0465-5, Section 2 constitutive equations; static circular-hole fields derived here
